caption: The manuscript embeds four chapters. Each chapter's headings sit under its embed, and the embed of Chapter 4 shows only the section The storm.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['embed-outline']; p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.words = true; app.workspace.rightSplit.expand(); await p.activateView(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Click a heading of an embedded chapter: the note scrolls to that heading inside the embed.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['embed-outline']; p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.words = true; app.workspace.rightSplit.expand(); await p.activateView(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.embed-outline-row')].find((r) => r.querySelector('.embed-outline-text')?.textContent === "A letter in the drawer")?.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Search for ferry to show the heading of an embedded chapter and its parent rows.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['embed-outline']; p.pro.signOut(); app.workspace.rightSplit.expand(); await p.activateView(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const input = document.querySelector('.embed-outline-search input'); input.value = 'ferry'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the letter embedded in Chapter 2 opens one level deeper. Without Pro it shows as a locked row.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['embed-outline']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('embed-outline-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); app.workspace.rightSplit.expand(); await p.activateView(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); p.settings.words = false; p.refreshViews(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the outline copied as a nested Markdown list, with a link to each heading and the word counts.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['embed-outline']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('embed-outline-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); app.workspace.rightSplit.expand(); await p.activateView(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const text = await p.copyOutline(); const f = await app.vault.create('Embed Outline/Outline copy.md', text); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).openFile(f); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getFileByPath('Embed Outline/Outline copy.md'); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); app.plugins.plugins['embed-outline'].pro.signOut(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Scroll the manuscript into Chapter 2: the outline marks First entries, a heading inside the embedded chapter.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['embed-outline']; p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.words = true; p.settings.highlight = true; app.workspace.rightSplit.expand(); await p.activateView(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown').find((l) => l.view.file?.path.endsWith('Manuscript.md')); const v = leaf.view; app.workspace.setActiveLeaf(leaf, { focus: true }); const sc = v.getMode() === 'preview' ? v.contentEl.querySelector('.markdown-reading-view .markdown-preview-view') : v.contentEl.querySelector('.markdown-source-view .cm-scroller'); for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const h = [...sc.querySelectorAll('.markdown-embed [data-heading]')].find((e) => e.getAttribute('data-heading') === 'First entries' && e.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0); if (h) { sc.scrollTop += h.getBoundingClientRect().top - sc.getBoundingClientRect().top - 2; break; } v.currentMode.applyScroll(12); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); return document.querySelector('.embed-outline-row.is-active .embed-outline-text')?.textContent ?? 'none'; })()
